PROGRESS NOTE

The patient returns for annual cardiology follow-up several years after surgical aortic
valve replacement. No chest pain, dyspnea, or syncope is reported today.

History: The patient underwent aortic valve replacement with a Carpentier-Edwards
bioprosthesis at an outside institution; the specific model name was not specified in the
records available at this visit.

Today's Echocardiogram: The prosthetic aortic valve leaflets move well. The mean gradient
is 12 mmHg, unchanged from the prior study, with no significant regurgitation.

Assessment: Normally functioning surgical aortic bioprosthesis.
Plan: Continue routine annual surveillance.
